title: Morning, sun
logline: Another of the mornings. The sunbreak. The mud gold, the channels blue, the sandpipers, the pup, the mug on the tailgate of the Legacy. Three weeks before the last page.

panels.composition: The flats at sunrise with a sunbreak through the cloud: the mud gold, the channels slate blue, a scatter of sandpipers lifting. The Legacy's tailgate at the page's left, down, with a chipped white enamel mug on it steaming. The pup out on the mud. A man's shadow, long, from the left edge onto the gold — the only part of him on the page.

characters.pose: a long shadow from the left edge

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, tidal mudflats at sunrise with a sunbreak turning the mud gold and the channels slate blue, sandpipers lifting, the lowered tailgate of an old green station wagon at the left edge with a steaming chipped white enamel mug on it, a small three-legged dog out on the mud, and a man's long shadow stretching from the left edge across the gold mud, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The mug on the tailgate. His shadow only. Three weeks before the end.
